description: This PHP source file defines the ActivitiesViewModulelistmenu class, which extends ViewModulelistmenu. It customizes the display method to retrieve recently viewed items for the current user, updates their item summaries and images, and assigns this data to the template engine before rendering a specific template.

classes.name: ActivitiesViewModulelistmenu
classes.description: A class that extends ViewModulelistmenu to display a customized module list menu showing recently viewed items with updated summaries and images.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Retrieves recently viewed items for the current user, updates their item summaries and images, assigns this data to the template system, and displays the module list menu template.
